Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lilas usually hope their child will grow to embody lily and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name "Lilas" holds deep spiritual meaning through its connection to the lily symbol. The lily is considered a representation of the Virgin Mary and her purity. It symbolizes Mary's role as a source of spiritual life and the beauty of God's creation. Moreover, it is also a reminder of the Christian belief in the transformation and renewal of the soul. Overall, the name "Lilas" embodies the ideals of purity, grace, and spiritual renewal central to the Christian faith.
